working-with-accountant.name: Working with an accountant
working-with-accountant.title: Working with an accountant: month-end close in pairs
working-with-accountant.lead: In pairs, students play a business owner and their accountant. They go through the month, add a missing document, clear up unclear payments and write a handover record.
working-with-accountant.metaDescription: Lesson for colleges, universities and courses: what an accountant needs from a business, VAT deadlines, missing documents, team permissions and a handover record. A demo task for pairs and a worksheet with answers. Czech rules.
goals: List what an accountant needs to close the month and by when.
Find and add a missing document.
Explain why the accountant has different permissions in the app from the owner.
Write a handover record for the month's documents.
teacherNotes: Students work in pairs. One starts the demo with the Owner role, the other with the Accountant role. Each has their own copy of the same company, so they pass findings on verbally and on paper, as in real life.

In the demo the accountant sees documents, VAT, exports and reports but does not touch company settings, the team or the subscription. In a real account the role is set in Settings, Team. Classroom mode invites nobody.

Deadlines the accountant watches: the VAT return within 25 days after the tax period (§ 136(4) of the Czech Tax Procedure Code) and an s.r.o.'s control statement every month within 25 days (§ 101e of the VAT Act). That is why accountants usually ask for documents by the 10th to 15th of the following month.

A document must have the details required by § 11 of the Accounting Act. The company, not the accountant, is responsible for its documents being correct: the accountant books what they receive. Accounting records are archived for at least 5 years (§ 31), a payer's tax documents for 10 years (§ 35 of the VAT Act).
In classroom mode, create a class with the Standard or Advanced level for this lesson. The Basics level switches off Expenses, Bank and Reports.

timeline.text: Explanation: what the accountant does, what the owner does and where it goes wrong.
Demo task in pairs: checking the month, a missing document, questions about the bank.
Handover record and worksheet.
Summary: the three things that save an accountant the most time.

concepts.title: Month-end close
concepts.body: The accountant checks that every bank transaction has a document and every document a payment, and prepares the VAT figures.

concepts.title: Missing document
concepts.body: A payment went out but its document is missing. Without it the payment cannot be booked as a cost and a VAT payer cannot claim the VAT.

concepts.title: Roles and permissions
concepts.body: The accountant needs documents, the bank and exports. Company settings, the team and the subscription stay with the owner, so nobody changes the details printed on invoices by mistake.

concepts.title: Handover record
concepts.body: A list of what the owner handed over for the month: the number of issued and received documents, statements, unclear payments and questions. Both sides then know what is missing.

task.intro: Lipová stezka s.r.o. is closing the month. One of the pair is the owner, the other the accountant.
steps: Accountant: open Bank and list the transactions that are not matched. Write a question for the owner about each.
Accountant: in Expenses find unpaid expenses and expenses without a document number. Add them to the list of questions.

Owner: answer the questions. You “found one receipt in the car”: open Expenses, New expense and record supplier Autoservis Brázda, description Tyre change, amount incl. VAT CZK 8,470, rate 21 %, document number 2026-077.
Accountant: open Settings and try to change the Business details. What happens? Why is that?
Together: write a handover record for the month on paper: number of issued invoices, number of received documents, unmatched payments, added documents and open questions. Both of you sign it.
task.check: Done when the pair has recorded the added expense, has a list of bank questions with answers and a signed handover record, and can explain why the accountant does not change company settings.

worksheet.q: By when must an s.r.o. file its control statement for March? Why does the accountant want the documents earlier?
worksheet.a: By 25 April. The accountant needs time to check and book the documents and sort out questions, so they want them by about 10 to 15 April.

worksheet.q: CZK 8,470 left the account and the document is missing. What does that mean for the company?
worksheet.a: The payment cannot be booked as a supported cost and a VAT payer cannot claim the VAT deduction until the document is there.

worksheet.q: Why does the accountant not change company details or the team in the app?
worksheet.a: Company details go on every invoice and the team decides who can see the data. That is the owner's responsibility.

worksheet.q: What belongs in a handover record?
worksheet.a: The period, the numbers of issued and received documents, statements, unmatched payments, added documents and open questions, the date and signatures.

worksheet.q: Who is responsible for documents being complete and true?
worksheet.a: The company, meaning the owner or the statutory body. The accountant processes what they receive.
